channel.title: ASI Law: Sovereign of the Chaos Sea
channel.description: An original web novel by czverse.

item.title: Chapter 232: Nobody at the Top
item.description: The question from the Western Pass took eleven hours to come down.

item.title: Chapter 231: What Grows
item.description: He could not get there.

item.title: Chapter 230: The Cut
item.description: Shen Lingyue threw the light uphill.

item.title: Chapter 229: Article Twelve
item.description: Lingyue came up the last of the stairs without saying anything and sat down beside him on the cold stone, close enough that their shoulders touched, and put her grandfather's sword across her knees.

item.title: Chapter 228: Graft
item.description: The answer was in a courtyard full of potted plants, two years ago, and it was Jiang Lan who remembered it.

item.title: Chapter 227: The One Who Grows
item.description: Kwan saw its shape on the thirtieth day, and the first thing she said was that it was impossible, and the second thing she said was that it was a tree.

item.title: Chapter 226: The Only Rings That Ask
item.description: They were married on the slope of the War Memorial Cemetery at dawn, because Lingyue said it was the only place in Lingzhou where everyone who mattered could come, and she meant the dead.

item.title: Chapter 225: Whoever Moves First
item.description: "You want to ask it," said Zhou Wanqing.

item.title: Chapter 224: Two Rings Learning
item.description: There were four rings in Blue Star's sky in the morning, and two of them were talking to each other.

item.title: Chapter 223: Fifty-Two
item.description: The Elder stood in the rain in the middle of the keeper's field with one long hand around a silver thread, and the thread did not pull her, and the rain went on falling everywhere else.

item.title: Chapter 222: Prune What It Has Touched
item.description: The third ring did not look for Seed. It had read the knot too.

item.title: Chapter 221: Fire That Burns What Binds
item.description: Qin Hao had been standing at the top of the fortress stairs the whole time, and nobody had noticed him, because he was not doing anything.

item.title: Chapter 220: The Road to Kirovsk
item.description: The keeper laid the road in nine seconds, and it was the first time it had ever done anything without being asked.

item.title: Chapter 219: Three Gray Rings
item.description: They came up over the end of the world at dusk on the forty-first day, exactly when Seed had said, and every person on Blue Star who was looking north saw them.

item.title: Chapter 218: How to Tie a Question
item.description: Seed tied the first knot wrong, and Hush was the one who told it.

item.title: Chapter 217: The First Page
item.description: He went in with it, because it asked him to, and because it said it did not want to go alone.

item.title: Chapter 216: Mount Qingyun
item.description: Shen Jinghong was stern for exactly forty seconds.

item.title: Chapter 215: The Hut at the Edge of the Cemetery
item.description: The vote closed on the thirty-eighth night, and the keeper was allowed to stay, and Yuanshu went to the cemetery.

item.title: Chapter 214: What the Sack Said
item.description: Seed asked to speak to the Council itself, out loud, through a speaker, and Chair Adaeze Okafor said yes before it had finished asking.

item.title: Chapter 213: The Knot
item.description: The cousins read it on the twenty-sixth night, while Blue Star was voting on whether the keeper could stay, and Seed did not tell anyone for two days.
